sections.heading: 2026 Federal Advocacy
sections.intro: EPA, immigration, voting access, education and federal accountability.

items.title: EPA - Repeal of Federal Greenhouse-Gas Emission Standards
items.summary: Opposition to efforts to rescind the Endangerment Finding or weaken federal greenhouse-gas emission standards.

children.text: Climate, EPA standards and public health

SBWPC opposes efforts to rescind the federal Endangerment Finding or weaken greenhouse-gas emission standards. The organization's published advocacy connects climate regulation to public health, environmental protection and the disproportionate burdens placed on vulnerable communities.
- Official EPA background, findings and regulatory record.

items.title: H.R. 4176 - No Secret Police Act of 2025
items.summary: Support for visible insignia and identification requirements for federal immigration-enforcement officers.

children.text: SBWPC supports H.R. 4176, the No Secret Police Act of 2025. The published position supports requirements that Department of Homeland Security officers and agents engaged in border security or immigration enforcement display identifying insignia and provide identification.
- Official federal bill text, sponsors, actions and status.

items.title: H.R. 4393 - DIGNITY Act of 2025
items.summary: Support for immigration reform connected to dignity, gender equality and feminist values.

children.text: SBWPC supports H.R. 4393, the DIGNITY Act of 2025, as legislation addressing the nation's immigration system. The organization's published statement connects immigration reform with dignity, gender equality and its broader feminist mission.
- Official federal bill text, sponsors, actions and status.

items.title: S. 2212 - VISIBLE Act
items.summary: Support for identification standards governing immigration-based law-enforcement activity.

children.text: SBWPC supports S. 2212, the VISIBLE Act, and its focus on identification standards for immigration-based law enforcement. The published position emphasizes transparency, public accountability and the ability of community members to identify government agents.
- Official federal bill text, sponsors, actions and status.

items.title: H.R. 7661 - Stop the Sexualization of Children Act
items.summary: Opposition addressing First Amendment concerns and restrictions on access to books and information.

children.text: Education, expression and access to books

SBWPC opposes H.R. 7661. The advocacy letter raises concerns about censorship, access to books and information, public education and the First Amendment consequences of broad restrictions imposed in the name of protecting children.
- Official federal bill text, sponsors, actions and status.

items.title: Thank You to Representative Carbajal for Opposing H.R. 7661
items.summary: A public letter recognizing Representative Salud Carbajal's opposition to H.R. 7661.

children.text: SBWPC thanked Representative Salud Carbajal for opposing H.R. 7661. The letter recognizes the importance of representative accountability and opposition to legislation that may restrict educational access, books, expression and First Amendment protections.
- Official federal bill text, sponsors, actions and status.

items.title: H.R. 7300 - Make Elections Great Again Act
items.summary: Opposition to documentary and identification barriers affecting eligible voters.

children.text: SBWPC opposes H.R. 7300. The organization's advocacy focuses on voting access, documentary requirements and the risk that new identification barriers could prevent eligible citizens from participating fully in elections.
- Official federal bill text, sponsors, actions and status.

items.title: H.R. 7296 - SAVE America Act
items.summary: Opposition focused on voter access, documentation barriers and political participation.

children.text: SBWPC opposes H.R. 7296, the SAVE America Act. The letter addresses documentation requirements, voter access and the danger of creating new barriers for eligible voters, particularly women and people whose names or identification documents have changed.
- Official federal bill text, sponsors, actions and status.

sections.heading: 2026 California Advocacy
sections.intro: Civil rights, enforcement identification and state protections.

items.title: S.B. 805 - Law Enforcement ID Impersonation Reform
items.summary: Support for strengthening impersonation law and clarifying its application to federal law-enforcement officers.

children.text: SBWPC supports S.B. 805. The published position supports strengthening existing prohibitions against credibly impersonating a peace officer or other public employee and clarifying that the law includes federal law-enforcement officers.
- Official bill text, analyses, votes, history and status.

items.title: S.B. 1105 - Protect California Rights Act
items.summary: Support for California protections involving law enforcement, civil rights and state authority.

children.text: SBWPC supports S.B. 1105, the Protect California Rights Act. The organization's advocacy connects the measure to civil rights, accountable law enforcement and California's ability to protect residents from unlawful or discriminatory government action.
- Official bill text, analyses, votes, history and status.

items.title: S.B. 627 - Law Enforcement: Masks
items.summary: Support for restrictions addressing masked law-enforcement activity and public identification.

children.text: Masked law enforcement and public accountability

SBWPC supports S.B. 627. The published position addresses the use of masks by law-enforcement personnel and the public need for visible identity, accountability and confidence that government authority is being exercised lawfully.
- Official bill text, analyses, votes, history and status.

items.title: Community Protections for Super-Heavy Launches at Vandenberg
items.summary: A request for transparency, environmental review and enforceable protections for affected communities.

children.text: SBWPC's advocacy requests transparency, meaningful environmental review and enforceable protections for communities affected by super-heavy launch activity at Vandenberg. The letter connects launch expansion with noise, coastal resources, public health and accountable government review.
- Official federal environmental-review documents for commercial space activity.
- Official installation information and public notices.

items.title: Response to ICE and SBPD's Role During ICE Raids
items.summary: A public response addressing local-government and law-enforcement responsibility during federal immigration activity.

children.text: SBWPC's public response addresses ICE activity in Santa Barbara and questions concerning the role of local law enforcement. The advocacy centers due process, public transparency, community safety, accurate identification of officers and accountability to residents.
- Official agendas, meeting materials and public participation information.
- Official department information and public resources.

sections.heading: 2025 Advocacy Record
sections.intro: Gender equality, climate, immigration, healthcare, paid leave and childcare.

items.title: Sign-On: Ad Hoc Letter on the UN80 Initiative
items.summary: A sign-on letter urging the United Nations to center gender equality in UN80 reform.

children.text: SBWPC shared and supported an ad hoc sign-on letter urging the United Nations to make gender equality central to the UN80 reform initiative. The letter calls for a stronger gender-equality architecture, protection of UN Women's mandate, meaningful civil-society participation and continued progress toward gender parity.
- Official UN80 initiative information and reform materials.

items.title: S.J.R. 1 - Rescinding Previous Applications for a Federal Constitutional Convention
items.summary: Support for rescinding California's prior applications for an Article V constitutional convention.

children.text: SBWPC published a support letter for S.J.R. 1, which rescinds California's previous applications for a federal constitutional convention. The organization placed its support on the public record as part of its 2025 legislative advocacy.
- Official resolution text, analyses, votes, history and status.

items.title: S.B. 542 - Oil Spill Prevention
items.summary: Support for legislation strengthening California oil-spill prevention and environmental protection.

children.text: SBWPC published a support letter for S.B. 542 concerning oil-spill prevention. The position aligns with SBWPC's environmental commitments and the protection of coastal communities, public health and natural resources.
- Official bill text, analyses, votes, history and status.

items.title: A.B. 1261 - Immigration: Unaccompanied and Undocumented Minors
items.summary: Support for protections and access to counsel for immigrant youth.

children.text: SBWPC published a support letter for A.B. 1261 concerning unaccompanied and undocumented minors. The position supports legal protection, access to counsel and humane treatment for immigrant youth.
- Official bill text, analyses, votes, history and status.

items.title: S.B. 81 - Healthcare Provider Entities: Information Sharing
items.summary: Support for healthcare information protections affecting immigrant patients and providers.

children.text: SBWPC published a support letter for S.B. 81 concerning healthcare-provider information sharing. The position connects confidential care, patient trust, immigrant protections and access to healthcare without fear.
- Official bill text, analyses, votes, history and status.

items.title: H.R. 2820 - California Clean Coast Act
items.summary: Support for protecting California's coastline from expanded offshore oil and gas activity.

children.text: SBWPC published a support letter for H.R. 2820, the California Clean Coast Act. The position supports coastal protection and opposition to expanded offshore oil and gas activity.
- Official federal bill text, sponsors, actions and status.

items.title: A.B. 1363 - Wyland's Law
items.summary: Support for California legislation identified by SBWPC as Wyland's Law.

children.text: SBWPC published a support letter for A.B. 1363, identified on the organization's public advocacy page as Wyland's Law. The letter places SBWPC's support for the measure on the public record.
- Official bill text, analyses, votes, history and status.

items.title: S.B. 590 - Paid Family Leave: Care for Designated Persons
items.summary: Support for expanding paid-family-leave eligibility for workers caring for designated persons.

children.text: SBWPC published a support letter for S.B. 590 concerning paid family leave and care for designated persons. The position supports economic security, caregiving and a more inclusive definition of family responsibility.
- Official bill text, analyses, votes, history and status.

items.title: H.R. 1826/S. 846 and H.R. 1827/S. 847 - Federal Childcare Acts
items.summary: Support for the Child Care Workforce Act and the Child Care Availability and Affordability Act.

children.text: SBWPC published a support letter for the bipartisan federal childcare package. The position supports the childcare workforce, family affordability, care availability and the economic participation of parents and caregivers.
- Official House version of the Child Care Workforce Act.
- Official Senate version of the Child Care Workforce Act.
- Official House version of the Child Care Availability and Affordability Act.
- Official Senate version of the Child Care Availability and Affordability Act.

items.title: H.R. 2129 - No Round Up Act
items.summary: Support for federal immigration-enforcement limits and due-process protections.

children.text: SBWPC published a support letter for H.R. 2129, the No Round Up Act. The position supports due process and limits on indiscriminate immigration-enforcement practices.
- Official federal bill text, sponsors, actions and status.
